授業科目の概要.曜日時限: 秋学期 水曜日 ２時限

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 基本的な力学に基づいて，エネルギー，一般化座標における運動方程式の定式化，平衡点の安定性解析を含む機械およびメカニズムのより高度な概念を学ぶ．
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: The course is built upon the course of basic mechanics and proceeds further to cover more advanced concepts of mechanics of machine and mechanisms, including the energy, formulation of motion equations in generalized coordinates, analysis of stability of equilibrium.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.その他: This course will involve lectures, problem exersise, and the final exam. 60% of the total score is required to pass the course. Students who will attend less than two thirds of the classes will be excluded from the final exam.
